# cut

Select byte ranges or delimited fields through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/cut -b 1-5 input.txt

moonx cli/cut -d : -f 1,3 records.txt
```

Read files or stdin and write selected portions of each record. Lists accept individual positions, ranges and open-ended ranges.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--only-delimited` | Skip undelimited records in field mode. |
| `-d VALUE`, `--delimiter VALUE` | Set the field delimiter; empty means NUL. |
| `-f VALUE`, `--fields VALUE` | Select fields. |
| `-b VALUE`, `--bytes VALUE` | Select bytes. |
| `-c VALUE`, `--characters VALUE` | Select characters under the C-byte profile. |
| `--complement` | Invert the selected positions. |
| `--output-delimiter VALUE` | Join selected fields/ranges; empty means NUL. |
| `-z`, `--zero-terminated` | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Selection is byte-oriented; character mode does not provide multibyte character slicing.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
